one_month_reasoning: The main event in the window is Q3 2026 results on Oct 29, 2026 (before the open, call at 10:00 ET). Consensus is about $9.92 EPS on $22.3B revenue (MarketBeat), below Q2's $23.0B, so the Street already expects a sequential dip. The 10-Q footnote puts the one-off Q2 rebate-estimate benefit at 3% of US revenue (~$430M). That benefit does not recur, and the CFO flagged European Q3 seasonality. Against that, Medicare Bridge enrolment reached ~600k by mid-September (Morgan Stanley conference, Sept 14) and Foundayo is ramping from $98M in Q2. CVS Caremark restores Zepbound as preferred from Oct 1, which helps Q4, not Q3. Q2 non-GAAP EPS of $8.38 included $3.03 of acquired IPR&D, so the underlying run-rate is well above the Q3 consensus. The bar is beatable, but the stock already fell ~8% in September on price-war and generic-filing headlines, and the 2027 outlook (not formal guidance until February) will drive the reaction more than the Q3 numbers. Also possible in the window: an FDA action on Foundayo for type 2 diabetes (submitted Q2 2026; Q4 timing not confirmed) and the FDA decision on Novo's CagriSema (Q4 2026). Net: close to neutral, median about $1,152, with monthly vol widened to ~11.5% (vs 35%/3.5 = 10%) for the earnings gap. I removed the round-1 claim of a ~$2 Q2 beat versus a ~$6.40 consensus because I could not verify it.

fair_value.method: 60% forward P/E (Oct-2027 NTM EPS ~$50.9 x 24x = ~$1,222) plus 40% DCF valued at end-2027 (consensus revenue path of $101B in 2027 and $113.9B in 2028, then fading growth; FCF margin 34-35%; 8% WACC; 3% terminal growth; = ~$1,018/share). Blended to ~$1,140 per share 12 months out.

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: 2027 revenue $101B (consensus); growth 11.6% (2028, consensus), then 9/7/6/5/4/4/3/3%; FCF margin 34% in 2028 and 35% after; WACC 8%; terminal growth 3%; net debt ~$15B at end-2027; ~880M shares. PV of 2028-36 FCF $306B plus PV of terminal value $606B = EV ~$911B.

inputs_detail.derivation: These replace my round-1 assumption of 20% growth in 2027. Consensus already reflects underlying US price of -9% (Q2) and the China NRDL price cuts.

Consensus FCF is $30.8B in 2027 (30%) and $38.6B in 2028 (34%). H1-2026 OCF of $16.0B less $5.3B capex shows the peak-capex trough (~25%); the 49-50.5% performance margin guide supports mid-30s once capex normalizes.

June 2026: total debt $54.9B (incl. $5.3B CP) less $9.0B cash and ~$3.9B investments. Consensus has net debt near zero by end-2027 ($0.8B). I hold $15B for continued buybacks and BD (Orna, Ajax, AtaiBeckley and a Scribe stake were all done in 2026).

Lilly's May 2026 notes priced at 4.375%-5.70% fixed coupons (pre-tax cost of debt ~5%). Beta of 0.45 implies a low CAPM cost of equity; I add a premium for policy risk (IRA selection, voluntary pricing agreement, MFN-style international alignment in the 10-Q) to reach 8%. 3% terminal growth because the franchise cycles to patent expiry (tirzepatide 2036+).

bear.story: Price war deepens: US underlying price erosion goes beyond -9% as PBMs (CVS now treats Lilly and Novo as co-preferred) extract larger rebates in 2027 bids. Novo's Wegovy pill (265k weekly TRx by July) and CagriSema take share. Medicare coverage after the Bridge program ends looks shaky (BALANCE Part D postponed indefinitely). Retatrutide is pushed onto the NDA path (5-year vs 12-year exclusivity) or its dysesthesia signal draws an FDA concern. Tirzepatide Paragraph IV suits become an overhang. 2027 EPS lands near $42 and 2028 near $45, at ~18x.

base.story: 2026 lands at or above the $85-87B guide. 2027 revenue is ~$100B and EPS ~$46-48 as volume (Medicare Bridge at 600k+ enrolees, CVS Zepbound restoration, Foundayo, China and new OUS markets) outruns price. Retatrutide is filed in Q1 2027. The multiple compresses to ~23-24x on ~$51 NTM EPS.

bull.story: Foundayo becomes the mass-market oral (T2D approval, ACHIEVE-4 CV benefit, OUS rollout). Retatrutide is filed as a BLA with best-in-class efficacy (~20-28% weight loss). Medicare coverage is extended past 2027 as management expects, employer coverage improves in 2027 benefit cycles, and 2028 EPS of ~$56 earns ~27x.

thesis_break_reason: About 29% below today and ~28% below my fair value; roughly 18x a reduced ~$45 NTM EPS. That level would most likely mean the incretin earnings path is broken: a structural US price reset (government-set or MFN prices extended to tirzepatide, or a PBM-driven collapse in net price well beyond -9%); clear share loss to oral or next-generation competitors (Lilly below ~50% of global incretin volume vs ~55-60% now); or a retatrutide regulatory or safety setback (NDA classification plus a dysesthesia concern). Ordinary 35% volatility rarely reaches that level without such news.

reasoning: Continuation of my round-1 primary-document work, now with full search. (1) Verified and corrected the inputs. 2027 consensus is $47.51 EPS and $102B revenue (+15.4%), and 2028 is ~$51-52 EPS and $113.9B, so I replaced my 20% 2027 revenue growth and $53.8 2028 EPS estimates. Consensus FCF of $30.8B/$38.6B backs a 34-35% margin. The 10-Q revenue note quantifies the Q2 rebate one-off at 3% of US revenue. It also discloses tirzepatide ANDA notices (July 2026), the Verzenio Cipla suit, Trulicity and Verzenio IRA prices from 2028, and the voluntary pricing agreement. The Q2 release shows EPS guidance absorbed $3.03 of IPR&D. The May 2026 notes (4.375-5.70%) anchor the cost of debt. (2) Bull evidence: Bridge enrolment of ~600k with 60-70% new patients; management expects Medicare coverage past 2027; CVS co-preferred status from Oct 1; ACHIEVE-4 Foundayo CV benefit (Sept 30); TRIUMPH-2 at 20.8% weight loss (23.4% at BMI 35+); 19 of 23 recent 2027 revisions upward. (3) Bear evidence: BALANCE Part D postponed; commercial coverage flat at ~50%; the Wegovy pill at 265k weekly TRx; CagriSema decision in Q4; retatrutide BLA/NDA dispute; dysesthesia; the stock fell ~8% in September on price-war and generic headlines. Valuation: P/E 24x on $50.9 NTM EPS = $1,222; DCF $1,018; blend $1,140 (was $1,170), roughly at spot and below the $1,329 mean analyst target (30 analysts, $930-1,600). Scenarios: $800 / $1,200 / $1,550 at 20 / 55 / 25%, mean ~$1,208. Ladder: lognormal with median ~$1,175 and sigma 0.32 (a little below 35% realized vol because the earnings path is visible), with the left tail fattened slightly for a policy or price shock. No option prices or implied volatility were used; nothing under priors/ was opened. Limits: Lilly IR static files (call deck, press release HTML) returned 503; Alpha Vantage and Twelve Data estimate endpoints were rate-limited or restricted to paid plans, so consensus comes from aggregator pages; no September IQVIA script data was found.
